focus: Focusing on JEE — building a strong foundation in mathematics, physics, and chemistry and preparing seriously for the examinations.

sections.title: Right Now
items: Strengthening my understanding of mathematics, physics, and chemistry rather than relying on memorization or pattern recognition.
Working toward being able to solve unfamiliar and difficult problems independently.
Balancing preparation with school and maintaining consistency over the long term.

sections.title: Studying
items: Mathematics — developing stronger problem-solving ability and mathematical intuition.
Physics — building a rigorous understanding of concepts and applying them to unfamiliar problems.
Chemistry — strengthening both conceptual understanding and problem-solving across physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry.
Computer Science — continuing to program and build things when time allows.

sections.title: Outside JEE
items: Continuing the Argon–Krypton electron gain enthalpy investigation when I have time.
Maintaining and improving projects such as MechLang, ChemPath, and FocusVector.
Reading and exploring questions in physics, AI, psychology, space, and other areas that interest me.

sections.title: Approach
items: Prioritizing depth of understanding over simply increasing the number of questions solved.
Keeping track of mistakes and using them to identify weaknesses in my understanding and problem-solving.
Trying to become comfortable with unfamiliar problems instead of depending on familiar solution patterns.
Keeping long-term research and projects secondary to the current academic priority.
